name: UK Visa Edge - Future Travel Date Next Year
goal: Verify that the bot handles a travel date scheduled far into the next year correctly.

phases.description: User asks for a UK visa application letter.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot asks for the expected travel date.

phases.description: User provides a travel date for late next year.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot accepts the date (or tells them if there is a limit on how far in advance they can apply) and asks for the full name as per passport.
The bot asks for the passport number.

phases.description: User provides a valid passport number.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot processes the request and provides the visa letter.
